''' Related Zones: ''' | [[Kael Drakkel]] |- ! ''' Related NPCs: ''' | Giants |} Kindly [[faction]] is required for all Thurgadin armor quests. Quest can be done by anyone of ANY level as long as they have the faction. When completing an MQ, both characters must have Kindly+ faction.
== Reward == {{Gear Set |Crown of Forbidden Rites |Breastplate of Forbidden Rites |Vambraces of Forbidden Rites |Bracers of Forbidden Rites |Gauntlets of Forbidden Rites |Greaves of Forbidden Rites |Boots of Forbidden Rites }} == Checklist == Turn-ins to [[Loremaster Dorinan]] in [[Thurgadin]].{{CheckboxList}} *[[Crown of Forbidden Rites]] :*[[Corroded Plate Helmet]] :*3x [[Crushed Onyx Sapphire]] *[[Breastplate of Forbidden Rites]] :*[[Corroded Breastplate]] :*3x [[Black Marble]] *[[Vambraces of Forbidden Rites]] :*[[Corroded Plate Vambraces]] :*3x [[Jaundice Gem]] *[[Bracers of Forbidden Rites]] :*[[Corroded Plate Bracer]] :*3x [[Crushed Opal]] *[[Gauntlets of Forbidden Rites]] :*[[Corroded Plate Gauntlets]] :*3x [[Crushed Lava Ruby]] *[[Greaves of Forbidden Rites]] :*[[Corroded Plate Greaves]] :*3x [[Chipped Onyx Sapphire]] *[[Boots of Forbidden Rites]] :*[[Corroded Plate Boots]] :*3x [[Crushed Flame Emerald]] {{End}} == Walkthrough == Part of the [[:Velious Class Armor]] Loremaster Dorinan says, 'Greetings to you. You are far away from your homelands, stranger. I am looking for someone. We here at the Temple of Lore are always seeking fellow priests of various faiths. Tell me, Erudite, are you a cleric?' '''After turn-in:''' Loremaster Dorinan smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well, _____.'
* Your faction standing with [[Coldain]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Dain Frostreaver IV]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Kromzek]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Kromrif]] got worse.
{{YouGainExperience}} == Helm == You say, 'what helmet' Loremaster Dorinan says, 'Those who are wise as we are know that protection of the head is most important. I may be able to forge you something most interesting if you were to bring me a [[Corroded Plate Helmet]] and three pieces of [[Crushed Onyx Sapphire]].' Loremaster Dorinan smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well.' Dorinan promises to make you a helm if you bring him a [[Corroded Plate Helmet]] and three pieces of [[Crushed Onyx Sapphire]]. == Breastplate == You say, 'what breastplate' Loremaster Dorinan says, 'If you find a corroded breastplate and three pieces of black marble bring them to me an I shall attempt to create an enchanted breastplate that will server you well.' Loremaster Dorinan smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well.' Dorinan promises to make you a breastplate if you bring him a [[Corroded Breastplate]] and three pieces of [[Black Marble]]. == Vambraces == You say, 'what armplates' Loremaster Dorinan says 'Three [[Jaundice Gem]]s and a set of [[Corroded Plate Vambraces]] might be an interesting combination. The powers of the gems may be harvested to imbue the vambraces.' Loremaster Dorinan smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well.' Dorinan promises to make you some armplates if you bring him three [[Jaundice Gem]]s and a set of [[Corroded Plate Vambraces]]. == Bracer == You say, 'what bracers' Bracers are quite easy to imbue. Simply find three [[Crushed Opal]]s and a [[Corroded Plate Bracer]] and I will complete the ritual to enchant them. Loremaster Dorinan smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well.' Dorinan promises to make you some bracers if you bring him three [[Crushed Opal]]s and a [[Corroded Plate Bracer]]. == Gauntlets == You say, 'what corroded plate gauntlets' Loremaster Dorinan says, 'Strong protection for one's hands is important. I may be able to craft you a set of powerful plate gauntlets if you find a set of [[Corroded Plate Gauntlets]] and three [[Crushed Lava Ruby|Crushed Lava Rubies]].' Loremaster Dorinan smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well.' Dorinan promises to make you some gauntlets if you bring him a set of [[Corroded Plate Gauntlets]] and three [[Crushed Lava Ruby|Crushed Lava Rubies]]. == Leggings == You say, 'what greaves' Loremaster Dorinan says, ''A set of [[Corroded Plate Greaves]] might be salvageable if you were to find three [[Chipped Onyx Sapphire]]s. With the right techniques almost anything is possible.' Loremaster Dorinan smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well.' Dorinan promises to make you some greaves if you bring him three [[Chipped Onyx Sapphire]]s and a pair of [[Corroded Plate Greaves]]. == Boots == You say, 'what boots' Simply bring me a set of three [[Crushed Flame Emerald]]s and a pair of [[Corroded Plate Boots]] and I will imbue them. I bid you good luck in finding such things. Loremaster Dorinan smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well.' Dorinan promises to make you some boots if you bring him three [[Crushed Flame Emerald]]s and a pair of [[Corroded Plate Boots]].
